note: W_brake, W_prov, W_final and W_final_max are the 23 Oct 2026 spec answer, in seconds. They are an open question wherever the basis says a live challenge contract was not read. Bond sizes are not in this file.

chains.name: Ethereum Sepolia
chains.basis: Ethereum L1 timers from the 23 Oct 2026 spec answer: 6h/1h, 2h, 24h. The root is posted by a bound poster. 2h is that answer's finality timer, not a Casper measurement.

chains.name: OP Sepolia
chains.basis: OP Mainnet timers from the 23 Oct 2026 spec answer: 6h/2h, 7d+6h, 18d. The claimant posts the root through DisputeGameFactory. Game type is snapshotted from the portal. Type 9 was specified for Unichain, not for OP, and was not read from a deployment.

chains.name: Base Sepolia
chains.basis: Base timers from the 23 Oct 2026 spec answer: 6h/24h, 5d+6h, 8d. 5d matches Base's published one-proof maturity. The respected game type was not read from a deployment.

chains.name: Unichain Sepolia
chains.basis: Same timers as OP Mainnet. Root verification reads DisputeGameFactory. Game type 9 is SUPER_CANNON_KONA, from the 23 Oct 2026 research correction. This path does not read an L2OutputOracle.

chains.name: Ink Sepolia
chains.basis: Ink uses the OP Mainnet timers from the 23 Oct 2026 spec answer. The respected game type was not read from a deployment, so the claim snapshots whatever the portal reports and refunds if it changes.

chains.name: Arbitrum Sepolia
chains.basis: Arbitrum timers from the 23 Oct 2026 spec answer: 6h/2h, 6d8h+6h, 15d. 6d8h is 547200 seconds. 45818 L1 blocks at 12 seconds is 549816 seconds, so 6d8h is shorter than that block count if blocks are 12 seconds. The stored figure is the spec answer, not a block-by-block reading.

chains.name: BSC Chapel
chains.basis: Watcher vote only. Timers from the 23 Oct 2026 spec answer: 6h/6h, 6h, 24h. A watcher vote cannot slash. An unresolved vote refunds the bond.

chains.name: Avalanche Fuji
chains.basis: Watcher vote only. Timers from the 23 Oct 2026 spec answer: 6h/6h, 6h, 24h.

chains.name: Monad testnet

chains.name: HyperEVM testnet

chains.name: Plasma testnet

chains.name: Solana devnet
chains.basis: Watcher vote only, same 6h/6h, 6h, 24h timers. No Solana program is deployed in v0. The numbers are config for a later program, not an on-chain brake.
